{{Top|leg}}
The '''Aspect of the Storm''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] technique that could turn the inky blackness of the sky into bright, white threads of lightning strikes. It is unknown if this is a variation or the same thing as [[Force storm (weather)|Force storm]].
